note: Tests that are RED on purpose: each pins a real, unfixed defect. The commit gate (npm run test:gate) tolerates exactly these and blocks any OTHER failure, so adding a feature cannot quietly break something that works today. Fix a defect -> delete its entry here. Never add an entry to make your own change pass.

expectedFailures.defect: Item ID search sends Contains on ID_BARCODE, which Scispot rejects; the fallback drops the ID filter, so item IDs never match.
toLot() is always called with linked=true, so the 'Matched by name' badge and 'not linked yet' warning are dead code.
EXPECTED_COLUMNS omits SHEETS.vendors, so a rename of 'SUP. Suppliers' raises no load-time warning.
labsheetUuid() matches sheet names with strict equality, so a case or whitespace difference breaks the Open button.
INV_COLS.locationFallback ('Location') is read but missing from EXPECTED_COLUMNS, so its rename shows no banner.
Unit options 'ng' and 'ug' are missing from UNIT_TABLE, so those lots are typed as counts and never join the mass total.
parseCount() uses Number(), so a comma decimal ('1,5') reads as NaN while parseUnit() accepts it.
Same root cause as GUARD-020, asserted against the UNIT_TABLE directly.
